results.collectionCensoredName: Short STORIES in easy FRENCH: Vol 747 pour Paris
results.description:
These short stories are perfect for advanced beginners: you'll be able to enjoy a whole story in French, grow your vocabulary in a natural way, and improve your comprehension whilst learning the correct pronunciation.

To maximize study effects, we recommend listening to this audiobook together with a paperback or ebook edition of « Short Stories in easy French – Vol 747 pour Paris », which contains useful French-English glossaries.

For students from beginner to intermediate level (A2-B2 on the Common European Framework of Reference)
